title: Conditional material properties: temper, thickness, temperature and orientation

provenance.citation: ASTM B209 and B557; EN 485; revision-bound mill certificates and material datasheets
provenance.locator: product form, temper, thickness and tensile testing
provenance.note: No property value is embedded in this pack; every value must come from a revision-bound source.

terminology.definition: The metallurgical condition produced by thermal or mechanical treatment, such as T6 or T651, that determines the property regime.
The material, product form, thickness, temperature, orientation and process conditions under which a property value is valid.

provenance.citation: ASTM B557 and material datasheet practice

models.name: Conditional material-property lookup with conflict and out-of-domain handling

equations.expression: applicable = material && grade && temper && property && thickness_in_range && temperature_in_range && conditions && orientation
two applicable records with different values => ambiguous, not averaged

assumptions.statement: A material property is conditional on material identity, grade, temper, product form/thickness, temperature, orientation and any established process condition.
A property record is used only when every declared condition is satisfied; there is no interpolation or extrapolation outside the record.
Two applicable records with different values are a conflict to surface, not a value to average.

validity_domains.statement: The material name, grade and temper must match the product actually specified; T6 thin sheet cannot substitute for T651 plate.
Thickness and temperature must lie inside the record's declared range; orientation and process conditions must also be established.
exclusions: missing orientation for an orientation-bound property

property_sources.property: yield strength, tensile strength and elongation
property_sources.authority: Revision-bound mill certificate or qualified material test report

provenance.note: No value is embedded in this pack.

property_sources.authority: Revision-bound material datasheet or test report

design_rules.rule: Select a property only from a record whose material, temper, thickness, temperature and orientation all cover the design condition.
Surface conflicting applicable records as an ambiguity; never average them.
design_rules.check: at most one distinct applicable value

manufacturing_rules.rule: Bind the mill certificate and heat/lot identity to the property record and the as-built part.

failure_modes.mode: strength shortfall from using the wrong temper or product form
failure_modes.cause: substituting a thin-sheet or different-temper property for the actual plate
failure_modes.detection: mill-certificate and temper verification plus tensile test

diagnostic_signatures.signature: measured strength outside the expected band and a temper marking that differs from the drawing

test_methods.method: Tensile test specimens cut from the actual product at the required location and orientation
test_methods.measures: yield strength, tensile strength and elongation

worked_cases.description: A 6061-T651 plate at 80 mm and 300 K must select a record covering that temper and thickness; a T6 thin-sheet record is not applicable.

inputs.name: material_grade
inputs.note: identifier encoded as a fixture number; not a property

inputs.name: temper
inputs.note: T651 identifier encoded as a fixture number

expected.name: matched_record_count
expected.note: a qualifying fixture record is required; no strength value is asserted

provenance.citation: Applicability fixture, not a material property source
provenance.note: No material strength is embedded or implied.

counterexamples.claim: Any 6061 aluminium has the familiar handbook strength.
counterexamples.refutation: Temper and product thickness change the allowable; a T6 thin-sheet record is not applicable to T651 plate at 80 mm. The lookup refuses or returns unavailable rather than substituting the familiar number.

known_traps.trap: Using a material property without checking temper, product form, thickness, temperature and orientation.
known_traps.why_shallow_fails: The material name matches, but the conditional property was measured on a different condition; the value is not applicable.
known_traps.guard: Require every declared applicability condition and return unavailable/out-of-domain/ambiguous rather than a number.
